result.description: Compact embedded storage module designed for environmental data capture, event buffering, and kiosk telemetry. Built around an NVMe interface for low-latency writes, it targets rugged edge devices rather than enterprise servers or graphics workloads. The module includes a high-endurance flash controller, on-board thermal logging, and power-loss protection for intermittent-field deployments.
result.title: Aster Vale 72GB M.2 NVMe Thermal Logging Module
